mapper.insert: insert into announcements(title, content, company_code, status, created_by, user_type, created_at) values(#{title}, #{content}, #{companyCode}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{userType}, NOW())

mapper.update: update announcements set title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() where id = #{id}

mapper.sql: a.company_code = 'C168' and a.status = 'ACTIVE' and a.created_at > case #{userType} when 'user' then (select u.created_at from `user` u where u.id = #{userId}) when 'owner' then (select o.created_at from `owner` o where o.id = #{userId}) when 'member' then (select ac.created_at from `account` ac where ac.id = #{userId}) end and not exists ( select 1 from announcement_read r where r.user_type = #{userType} and r.user_id = #{userId} and r.announcement_id = a.id)
